author: curriculum-architect
songSummary: Practices five fingers on five keys, spotting patterns that shift and skip, counting in a bar and song shape, using a gentle rowing song.

classes.title: Five fingers in the boat
classes.goal: Hear the song, then find C and rest one finger on each of five keys.

mathTarget.parentLine: Five fingers, five keys: one finger for each key

classes.parentPrompt: Point to the two black keys; help your child rest the thumb on C, the rest beside it.
classes.childAction: Thumb on C, then one finger on each key: one to five.
classes.bridge: Five keys are five seats in the boat; each finger sits in one seat.

intro.caption: Find the two black keys
intro.parentCue: C is the white key just left

games.caption: One finger, one key
games.parentCue: Say the finger number for each key

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: five fingers on five keys, one each.

classes.title: Row, then row one lower
classes.goal: Learn the first line and hear its second half copy the first, one step lower.

mathTarget.parentLine: The same little shape, moved one key lower

classes.parentPrompt: Say 'five, three, three' then 'four, two, two' as your child plays.
classes.childAction: Play 5-3-3, then the same shape lower: 4-2-2.
classes.bridge: Lightly row: one oar stroke, then the same stroke one key to the left.

intro.caption: Same stroke, one key lower
intro.parentCue: point to G, then to F, to start each part

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: spotting a pattern that moves one key lower.

classes.title: Skipping stones
classes.goal: Learn the 'silent tide' line, which skips over every other key.

mathTarget.parentLine: Jumping over one key each time: one, three, five

classes.parentPrompt: Tap your child's fingers one, three and five, and wiggle the skipped fingers two and four.
classes.bridge: Like a stone skipping on water: hop over a key, hop over again.

intro.caption: Hop over a key
intro.parentCue: tap fingers one, three and five on their hand

games.caption: Silent tide: C, E, G
games.parentCue: Say one, three, five, five, one

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: a pattern that skips every other key.

classes.title: Four Ds in a bar
classes.goal: Learn the 'winds and waters' lines and count the repeated notes, one to four.

mathTarget.parentLine: Counting one, two, three, four on the same key

classes.parentPrompt: Count 'one, two, three, four' out loud with each D, then cheer on the step up.
classes.childAction: Play D four times while counting, then keep going up.
classes.bridge: Four even oar strokes on the same key, then the boat moves on.

intro.caption: Count the oar strokes
intro.parentCue: count one to four aloud with your child

games.caption: One, two, three, four on D

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: counting four even beats in a bar.

classes.title: The rowing line comes back
classes.goal: Play the whole song slowly and notice the rowing line returns three times.

mathTarget.parentLine: One line keeps coming back between the new parts

classes.parentPrompt: Each time 'lightly row' comes back, make a rowing motion together and smile.
classes.childAction: Play the song slowly; row your arms when the rowing line returns.
classes.bridge: The rowing line is the boat; the other lines are new places it visits.

intro.caption: Listen for the rowing line
intro.parentCue: row your arms each time it comes back

games.caption: Tap the beat: the first line
games.parentCue: Play the blue keys; your child taps the beat

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: hearing which line of a song comes back.

classes.title: Climb the five stairs
classes.goal: Practise the climb from C to G slowly, so finger four gets a turn too.

mathTarget.parentLine: Fingers in order: first, second, third, fourth, fifth

classes.parentPrompt: Rest a hand lightly on your child's wrist and say each finger number as they climb.
classes.childAction: Climb C to G slowly, one finger after another.
classes.bridge: O'er the glassy waves: five stairs up, one finger on each stair.

intro.caption: Five stairs, slowly up
intro.parentCue: say each finger number as they climb

games.caption: O'er the glassy waves
games.parentCue: Say one, two, three, four, five

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: moving fingers one after another, in order.

classes.title: Glide smooth and even
classes.goal: Play the whole song slowly, keeping every note the same even length.

mathTarget.parentLine: Every beat the same length, like even oar strokes

classes.parentPrompt: Pat a slow, steady beat on your child's back while they play.
classes.childAction: Play slowly and evenly, like a boat gliding on calm water.
classes.bridge: Smoothly glide: each note is one even stroke, never a splash.

intro.caption: Glide like a calm boat
intro.parentCue: pat a slow beat on your child's back

games.caption: Tap and count to four
games.parentCue: Count softly as your child taps

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing slowly with an even beat.

classes.title: Row to a higher lake
classes.goal: Move the hand to a higher C and play the same song with the same fingers.

mathTarget.parentLine: The same tune and fingers, moved to a new spot

classes.parentPrompt: Help your child find the next C to the right, then ask: which lake sounds nicer?
classes.childAction: Find the higher C, then play the same song up there.
classes.bridge: The same boat on a higher lake: same fingers, brighter sound.

intro.caption: Same song, higher lake
intro.parentCue: find the next C to the right together

games.caption: Silent tide, up high
games.parentCue: Say one, three, five, five, one

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing the same tune in a new place.

classes.title: Row with the music
classes.goal: Play the whole song along with the music and keep going to the end.

mathTarget.parentLine: Keeping pace with the music, like rowing with a friend

classes.parentPrompt: Sing the words softly beside your child; if they miss a note, keep singing.
classes.childAction: Play along with the music; keep rowing even after a slip.
classes.bridge: Two rowers in one boat pull at the same time.

intro.caption: Row with the music
intro.parentCue: sing softly beside your child and keep going

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: keeping pace with the music to the end.

classes.title: A light little boat
classes.goal: Play the whole song for teddy, with light gentle fingers like calm water.

mathTarget.parentLine: Playing lightly so the music sounds like calm water

classes.parentPrompt: Sit teddy as the audience; whisper 'lightly' before you start, then clap and bow.
classes.childAction: Play lightly for teddy, then take a big bow.
classes.bridge: Light fingers make light ripples; the boat glides home to C.

intro.caption: A song for teddy!
intro.parentCue: sit teddy in front and whisper lightly

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing a whole song with light fingers.
